measurement_policy: Preserve 91 complete cells. Complete the 20 unstarted cells. Replace exactly one failed measurement with all original first 20 pairs in a new empty namespace, once. Failure-triggered, independent of observed speed or predictions; no best-of attempts. Any further failure stops and requires a new terminal audit, never automatic remeasurement.
analysis_policy: Both latency records and execution walltime must use the same explicitly mapped measurement. Old nine successes and 21 failed attempts remain diagnostic/cost evidence, never mixed with replacement latency or throughput. All spending is retained. Different collection times and failure-contingent replacement must be disclosed.

global shared and replica exclusive locks
fresh shared budget check and original per-call account
exclusive durable attempt and per-cell start/end provenance
private frozen analysis with consistent explicit source mapping
independent final raw/execution/cost/report validation before Core completion
